messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: detected latency spike on /v1/generate (p95 > 2.5s) in us-west-2. Alert triggered at 14:02 UTC. Paging primary oncall.

raf: grabbing this — im primary for the shift. looking at graphs now.

elaine: on standby, can take handoff if you need to go heads-down. what customer impact do we have?

raf: initial telemetry shows 4% of requests hitting >2s p95, error rate stable. some large bursts from a single client id. digging into traces.

sanjay: posting runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-spike and quick mitigation checklist: 
```
- pause noncritical background jobs
- scale inference pool (dedicated) by +1 replica
- enable model-fallback for heavy requests
- re-route traffic from us-west-2 -> us-east-1 if needed
```

maria: fyi we just got a support ticket from AcmeCorp complaining about slow responses at 13:58 UTC. might be the same. I can keep them updated if someone drafts a short status.

raf: ok i'll try a quick scale first. running terraform scale command.

raf: `./infra/scale_dedicated.sh --region us-west-2 --pool inference-dedicated-1 --add 1`

incident-bot: Deploy/rescale job started (job id: j-67432). ETA ~90s.

lee: suggest also temporarily lowering max tokens for long-running requests from 4096 -> 1024 for impacted model route. less ideal but reduces evictions.

elaine: i can patch the route config if you want me to. will need a quick canary and rollback plan.

raf: pls do the patch and route 10% traffic to new config as canary. share the snippet here.

elaine: patching now. config diff: 
```
- max_tokens: 4096
+ max_tokens: 1024
+ canary_percentage: 10
```

elaine: applied canary. monitoring latency.

sanjay: rescale job complete. nodes added, pod readiness green.

raf: seeing p95 drop to 1.1s for the canary shard. global p95 still ~1.8s.

maria: AcmeCorp replied — they see slight improvement but still slower than usual. i've told them we're actively mitigating and will follow up in 15m.

raf: given the ongoing customer chatter, i need to hand primary to @elaine so i can dig into the client-side traces. elaine ok to swap primary?

elaine: i can take primary now. raf — how do you want to handoff notes?

raf: posting quick summary in case you need it: 
- root cause unknown, spike concentrated on /v1/generate in us-west-2
- scale completed, partial improvement seen
- canary lowering max_tokens to 1024 for heavy routes (10% traffic)
- single client id producing high QPS -> being investigated (trace id: t-9a7f)
- AcmeCorp impacted, support notified

elaine: got it. i'm accepting primary. updating oncall roster.

elaine: @oncall-bot swap --from raf --to elaine --scope primary

oncall-bot: Oncall swap recorded: raf -> elaine. Primary oncall: elaine. Secondary: sanjay. Please confirm.

elaine: confirming — i'm primary. raf — you're secondary/backup for now? also assign any followups to raf if you want him to continue traces.

raf: i'll stay on traces and handover any findings in 20m. thanks.

sanjay: checking runbook step 3: model-fallback is enabled but not tested for this client ID. suggest enabling fallback rule for the route for immediate safety net.

elaine: enabling fallback for route /v1/generate-heavy -> smaller model (gpt-small). will flip for 100% if we see regressions.

maria: drafting status update for customers: "We've identified increased latency in us-west-2 and applied autoscaling and route-level mitigations. We're monitoring and will update in 15 minutes." OK to post?

elaine: ok to post. include link to status page: https://status.redwood.com/incident/INC-2188888888

raj: (not on thread originally but pinging) if there's any chance of traffic reroute to us-east-1, i can prep traffic rules.

elaine: thanks raj — hold on, i'm going to wait 10m to see canary + fallback effect, then decide on cross-region reroute.

raf: small note — if you need me to re-assume primary, react with :hand: and i'll switch back.

maria: posted customer status. link: https://status.redwood.com/incident/INC-2188888888/updates/1

sanjay: monitoring shows error rate unchanged, latency improving slowly. fallback started serving ~0.6% of requests for canary.

elaine: copying runbook checklist here for any future oncall: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-spike#steps-for-primary — includes exact commands and escalation contacts.

raf: thanks all. handing off full context to elaine in our incident doc. i'll still be around for traces.

elaine: confirmed primary takeover. will coordinate the next update in 15 minutes and, if stable, will close the active mitigation.

incident-bot: Alert resolved automatically at 14:27 UTC (alert condition no longer met).

elaine: saw the auto-resolve, but we'll keep monitoring for 30m. raf — leaving follow-on trace investigation ticket: TICKET-5421 assigned to raf.

raf: ack TICKET-5421. will post findings in that ticket and update thread if i find root cause.

maria: thanks everyone. threading notes into the incident playbook.

elaine: final: primary remains elaine, secondary sanjay for next 45 minutes. handback if nothing new. :white_check_mark:
